causes.label: Water temp selection
remedies: Some fabrics will feel wetter when rinsed with cold water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Water temp selection"

causes.label: Use of fabric softener
remedies: For best results, GE recommends use of dryer sheets to freshen clothes and reduce static cling.
If you prefer to use liquid fabric softener, please add near the end of the wash (agitate) portion of the cycle, before the water drains.
The “washing” light will flash when it is time to add fabric softener.
Use of liquid fabric softener during the low-water, high-efficiency rinse can cause spotting on clothes.
Rewashing will remove these spots.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Not enough detergent
remedies: Use more detergent (especially with larger loads).
Be sure to follow detergent manufacturer’s directions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Not enough detergent"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Select load size to match clothes load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Detergent is not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water before you load clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Detergent is not dissolving"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Clothes are air or line dried"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water, before you load clothes.
Try a liquid detergent.
Use warmer water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Detergent not dissolving"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket.
Make sure load size selected matches clothes load size.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: See actions under “Colored spots.”
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics
remedies: While this is not caused by the washer, you can slow the pilling process by washing garments inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 8: "Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer may pause during the spin cycle to remove soapy water more efficiently.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "This is normal"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open
remedies: Close lid.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Lid is open"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: START was not pressed
remedies: Press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "START was not pressed"

causes.label: Extremely low water pressure
remedies: Press START again.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Extremely low water pressure"

causes.label: Lid magnet missing
remedies: Call for service.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 9: "Lid magnet missing"

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to HE detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and at washer.
Make sure end of drain hose is properly connected to washer and correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency
remedies: New laundry detergents have been formulated to work with cooler water temperatures without affecting wash performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency"

causes.label: Control is not set properly
remedies: Check cycle selection and adjust.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Control is not set properly"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "House water heater is not set properly"

causes.label: All the water in your household water heater has been used
remedies: Wait until the water in the water heater is heated to the correct temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "All the water in your household water heater has been used"

symptoms.symptom: Water pumped out before cycle is complete

causes.label: Lid lifted or cycle was put in pause for over 24 hours
remedies: Reset cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Lid lifted or cycle was put in pause for over 24 hours"

causes.label: Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected
remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.
Top of drain outlet should be less than 6 ft (1.8 m) above floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected"

causes.label: Washer in spin cycle
remedies: Spray rinse during a spin cycle is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 10: "Washer in spin cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Quick short agitation sounds at end of agitate

causes.label: Clothing redistribution
remedies: At the end of agitate, the motor makes short agitation strokes to redistribute the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Clothing redistribution"

causes.label: Relay switch
remedies: The relay makes a click sound when activated.
The water level activates the relay and stops filling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Relay switch"

symptoms.symptom: Motor “whining up” or “coasting down” in spin

causes.label: Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle
remedies: The motor will speed up incrementally during the spin cycle.
When spin is complete, it will coast until it stops.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Motor ramping up/down during spin cycle"

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: The drain pump will make a humming sound when pumping out water after agitation stops and continue until spin is complete.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water drain pump"

causes.label: Water drain pump
remedies: When the pump starts drawing in air, it starts to gurgle.
The washer should then begin spinning and the sound will continue until it is done spinning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Water drain pump"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: To level the front of the washer, adjust the front leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
To level back of washer, lift back of machine 4″ (11 cm) and set down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Washer is uneven"

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Press PAUSE to stop the washer, open the lid and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the lid and press START.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: Shipping rod is still assembled in unit
remedies: To remove shipping rod from washer, pull yellow tag and attached rod from the bottom right hand side of washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 11: "Shipping rod is still assembled in unit"

symptoms.symptom: Labels on the exterior of the washer will not peel off cleanly

causes.label: Occasionally the adhesive used on the labels does not release cleanly
remedies: Use a hair dryer set at the lowest heat setting, directing the air at the label for a short amount of time.
This will release the adhesive easily, without damaging the surface of the washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Occasionally the adhesive used on the labels does not release cleanly"

symptoms.symptom: Movement inside machine when shut off

causes.label: Shifting mechanism is disengaging the motor
remedies: When the machine is manually turned off, the shifter will disengage the motor before completely shutting down.
If the lid is raised before the motor is disengaged, it will resume when lid is closed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Shifting mechanism is disengaging the motor"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: This machine uses three low-water spray rinses to remove soap from clothes and reduce water consumption.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "This is normal"
